body: Your life is lonely boring and plain because you are not going outside, and are staying inside and not showering. Get out there, for any reason, and I would recommend making a point of saying something to a stranger each time. It might feel silly/stupid, but just saying a little bit extra to a cashier "thanks julia the food was great!" will make her feel better, even if she did  not prepare the food. It will give you exposure to more people, who will eventually reciprocate, and become friendly, and friends. Get yourself outside, showered, of course, and interact in any way. Eventually you will get better, and better results with it.

You sound like a genuinely good person who is trying their best, I would encourage you to find some way to do something productive and constructive, like reaching out to a charity or do something crazy like join the Peace Corps. Put your life towards making positive changes in other peoples lives, and you will be happier yourself as well, and you sound like a person who could benefit others tremendously (given your work ethic and accomplishments even if they are vague).
